capacity-capacity.metric_scope: Warm request latency; excludes setup, dumps and profiling. Ratio is the median of paired round mean-latency ratios.
capacity-capacity.interpretation: A threshold crossing flags capacity-sensitive timings; repeat under comparable clocks and temperatures to confirm.
